title: Parabilis Medicines (PBLS) Q3 2026 results — its second report as a public company, 24 sessions before its lock-up ends
source: NEWS: no date announced by the company. Aggregators (WebSearch 2026-11-06) project 2026-11-12 before the market (Yahoo Finance, Earnings Whispers; TradingView shows 2026-12-02). Cross-checked against EDGAR (data.sec.gov submissions, fetched 2026-11-06): Q2 8-K Item 2.02 and the 10-Q were both filed 2026-08-13, a Thursday, 44 days after quarter end; 44 days after 2026-09-30 is 2026-11-13, so 11-12 or 11-13 are both on pattern. Filed estimate: the company has not announced it
notes: Discovered during the pbls-lockup-expiry-2026-12-06 initial research (2026-11-06). It reacts before the lockup study's D-10 window opens (2026-11-20), and its 10-Q refreshes the share count behind the unlock arithmetic. PBLS closed 2026-11-05 at 27.88 with 20-day realized vol of 98%.
